## [1.12.2-dev.1](https://github.com/xob0t/morphe-patches/compare/v1.12.1...v1.12.2-dev.1) (2026-08-18)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **ozon:** support common cell migration in 19.31 ([7619fcf](https://github.com/xob0t/morphe-patches/commit/7619fcfb1c40209d0c1f8f9908b05699d27ce599))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.

patches.name: Block listings
patches.description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics and Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper.

patches.name: Disable update prompts
patches.description: Prevents Avito's force-update screen opener from launching update screens. Toggleable in Настройки Morphe.

patches.name: Hide professional sellers
patches.description: Adds a maximum seller review count to Avito search filters and hides or dims offers from sellers above that limit.

patches.name: Morphe settings
patches.description: Adds a "Настройки Morphe" entry to Avito's settings that hosts the configuration for the other Morphe patches.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables Avito ads by removing ad SDK entry points and short-circuiting commercial banner loading.

patches.name: UI tweaks
patches.description: Optional interface tweaks, each toggleable in Настройки Morphe: single-row home categories, hide the "Подписки" tab in Избранное, hide installments (Рассрочка) and the "Спросите у продавца" block on offers, expand descriptions by default (no "Читать далее"), hide reserved offers and offer recommendations, hide profile raffle, referral and Avito Pro promos, and hide the Avi assistant tab in the bottom navigation.

patches.name: Bypass anti-tamper
patches.description: Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.

patches.name: Remove TBank ads
patches.description: Removes TBank stories and promotional surfaces.

patches.name: Remove Wildberries ads
patches.description: Removes Wildberries home banners, grid banners, profile banners, promo headers, product recommendations, and lottery popups.

options.description: Removes recommendation grids from cart and product screens.

patches.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.

options.description: Removes recommendation grids from product, cart, profile, and favorites screens.
